name: pro-security
description: The Security phase: security-audit, a read-only whole-repository audit covering secrets archaeology, dependency supply chain, CI/CD exposure, container and IaC misconfiguration, webhook and integration gaps, LLM/AI attack surface, agent-skill supply chain, OWASP Top 10, and STRIDE threat modeling. Findings carry a confidence score, quoted evidence, and a concrete exploit path. Ships the security-auditor subagent for independent finding verification. Adapted from the cso skill in garrytan/gstack.
